introduce:
Place your right hand on the left side of your head.

Exhale, gently pull your head towards the right.

Hold for a few seconds, breathing naturally.
name: SIDE NECK STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please always keep your left shoulder flat.

introduce:
Place your left hand on the right side of your head.

Exhale, gently pull your head towards the left.

Hold for a few seconds, breathing naturally.
name: SIDE NECK STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please always keep your right shoulder flat.

introduce: Sit upright. Extend your left leg in front of you with your heel on the ground and toes pointing up.\n\nReach both of your hands towards your toes. Hold this position, breathing deeply and steadily.
name: SEATED HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please keep your knee straight during the stretch.
Please keep the other foot flat on the ground.

introduce: Sit upright. Extend your right leg in front of you with your heel on the ground and toes pointing up.\n\nReach both of your hands towards your toes. Hold this position, breathing deeply and steadily.
name: SEATED HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please keep your knee straight during the stretch.
Please keep the other foot flat on the ground.

introduce:
Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Exhale, hinge forward from the hips, using your left hand to push your knee down toward the ground.

Hold for a few seconds, breathing deeply and steadily.
name: CHAIR GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: To make a deeper stretch, pull your crossed leg closer to your body.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and glutes and can reduce your lower back pain.

introduce:
Put your right ankle on your left knee.

Exhale, hinge forward from the hips, using your right hand to push your knee down toward the ground.

Hold for a few seconds, breathing deeply and steadily.
name: CHAIR GLUTE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: To make a deeper stretch, pull your crossed leg closer to your body.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and glutes and can reduce your lower back pain.

introduce: Sit upright. Inhale, lift your toes off the ground, rocking back onto your heels.\n\nExhale, rock forward, lifting your heels off the ground onto your toes. Repeat.
name: CHAIR HEEL TO TOE ROCK

tips.text: Keep your feet parallel and your ankles stable.
Please pause at the top for a few seconds.
Inhale as you rock back, and exhale as you rock forward.
This exercise is great for improving ankle mobility and balance.

introduce: Take a deep breath and as you exhale, slowly curl your chin to your chest, draw your lower belly in and round your back.\n\nFold your body and press your entire palms on the floor. With every exhalation, move your chest and shoulders away from your thighs. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This pose helps to release tightness in your neck, shoulders, lower back, and hips.

introduce:
Sit with your legs a little wider than hip-width apart.

Release your legs and windshield wiper your legs from side to side.

Breathe rhythmically throughout the exercise.
name: CHAIR WINDSHIELD WIPERS

tips.text: This exercise warms up your hips and knees.

introduce:
Sit on the edge of the chair. Inhale, open your left leg out towards the left. Make sure your knee is aligned with your ankle, pointing in the same direction as your toes and forming a 90-degree angle.

Exhale, extend your right leg to the right with your toes facing forward. Raise your arms to your sides at shoulder height with your palms down.

Draw your belly in, tuck your tailbone down, and lift your chest. Take your gaze to your left hand. Hold this position.
name: CHAIR WARRIOR II LEFT

tips.text: Don't let your bent knee go over your toes.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears and keep them relaxed.
This exercise strengthens your lower body and shoulders.

introduce:
Sit on the edge of the chair. Inhale, open your right leg out towards the right. Make sure your knee is aligned with your ankle, pointing in the same direction as your toes and forming a 90-degree angle.

Exhale, extend your left leg to the left with your toes facing forward. Raise your arms to your sides at shoulder height with your palms down.

Draw your belly in, tuck your tailbone down, and lift your chest. Take your gaze to your right hand. Hold this position.
name: CHAIR WARRIOR II RIGHT

tips.text: Keep your bent knee in line with your toes.
Don't let your bent knee go over your toes.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears and keep them relaxed.
This exercise strengthens your lower body and shoulders.

introduce:
Cross your right leg over your left.

Inhale, lengthen your spine. Exhale, slowly twist your body to the right as much as possible with your gaze over your right shoulder.

Press your left hand against the outside of your right knee to deepen the twist, and place your right hand on the chair behind you for support.

Hold this position.
name: CHAIR SPINAL TWIST LEGS CROSSED RIGHT

tips.text: Let your head follow the movement of your body.
This exercise helps increase spinal flexibility and relax back muscles.

introduce:
Cross your left leg over your right.

Inhale, lengthen your spine. Exhale, slowly twist your body to the left as much as possible with your gaze over your left shoulder.

Press your right hand against the outside of your left knee to deepen the twist, and place your left hand on the chair behind you for support.

Hold this position.
name: CHAIR SPINAL TWIST LEGS CROSSED LEFT

tips.text: Let your head follow the movement of your body.
This exercise helps increase spinal flexibility and relax back muscles.
